title: Consumer
description: Meta-schema for consumers/*.json (NOT consumers/waivers/). Declares a UNS consumer (edge / middleware / gateway / script) with its stage, ring and (required) feedback contract. A CARRIER lists the sources it carries (carries, exclusive: a source has one carrier or one waiver) and its capacity. A READER lists what it reads of the model (reads: no coverage duty, never exclusive, not counted against capacity). EVERY consumer declares feedback (how it reports what it has loaded). A consumer may be both (Block B, 24.09.).

reads.description: Paths of the model this consumer reads, relative to the tree root: a class directory ending in / (profiles/), a subdirectory (sources/opcua/) or one file (sources/it/x.json). Each path must exist in the tree.

authoring.description: locked: configured only from the model, no local editor · compiled: its configuration is generated from the model (bundle) and deployed, a local editor exists but does not change it · open: a local editor is the truth, the state is never known (always unknown).
